detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Two new hotels are opening in the Canary Islands and soon guests will be flying in from all over the globe to visit your subtropical island resorts in Hotel Architect - Poolside Paradise.  

Your job is to provide the perfect getaway for critics and guests alike, but managing a hotel on an island paradise requires more than just sunshine and palm trees. Whether your guests are looking to get active in the wellness areas or seek a dip in the refreshing hotel pool, you will need to create a hotel paradise worthy of a 5-Star rating.  

Relaxation relies on careful planning, creative logistics, and a seasoned hotel manager (that's you). Do you have what it takes?  

In Hotel Architect - Poolside Paradise you can:  

  • Open a pool resort in the brand-new 'Gran Canaria' and 'Tenerife' scenarios   

  • Build and Design Swimming Pools 

  • Hire a new staff type to ensure pools are maintained for top customer satisfaction  

  • Build new outdoor gym and wellness areas for active stays

  • Design your hotel and pool area with a whole host of new items and decorations  

  • Plus much, much more!
